title: Plugin install warning about the HUD view setting (#682.6)
context: Issue 682 item 6 asks that 'claude plugin install paqad@eliyce' stop printing '1 userConfig option not yet set'. The installed Claude Code 2.1.302 binary counts an option as not set when no value is saved for it; the 'default' in plugin.json is ignored by that check. So there is no way to declare the 'view' option in plugin.json and avoid the warning. The fix needs a product choice about where the HUD on/off setting lives.

options.label: Remove the view option from plugin.json and turn the HUD on or off with a paqad setting (on by default). The install prints no warning; /plugin configure no longer shows the toggle.
